svg.title: Isochrones on foot and by bicycle from the Praça Municipal, Salvador, without and with elevation
svg.desc: Four maps of central Salvador. On the left, the areas reached from the Praça Municipal, on the escarpment of the upper city, within 10, 20 and 30 minutes walking and cycling on flat ground; on the right, the same with the slopes, smaller, with the flat 30-minute outline dashed.

g.text: Areas reached in 10, 20 and 30 minutes on foot and by bicycle. Right: with Tobler's slope costs
(Copernicus DEM GLO-90); dashed: the flat 30-minute isochrone
From the Praça Municipal, Salvador: flat and with slopes
